critique.title: Both reviewers now prefer Torii on matched console tasks
critique.text: Repeated direct screenshot comparisons favor Torii’s readable hierarchy, restrained shell, explicit actions, provider setup, routing and generic client connection. Catalog density and accounting remain honest ties. The final keyboard regression was reproduced and fixed. Reviews concern existing Torii workflows; they do not establish whole-product superiority or comparative Routerly mobile behavior. Final verification passes 99 console tests, full Go/race tests, vet/build and disposable non-root runtime checks.

note: Native captures support readability judgments; references are 1800px wide and Torii captures 1430/1440px. Branding prevents fully blind review. Benchmarks use synthetic local results. Routerly experiments and Torii benchmark evidence are different workflows.

history.title: Baseline · 8 October 2026
history.text: Browser regression tests and Go web/gateway tests pass. Public Routerly screenshots and workflow documents downloaded for direct review.

history.title: First revision · e0d5d6f
history.text: Compact neutral visual system, responsive navigation, live overview, searchable model table, provider dialogs and metadata-first activity. 78 browser unit checks pass; Go web/gateway baseline passes.

history.title: Independent review · Round 1
history.text: Actual Chromium captures across eight pages, mobile at 390px, and direct comparison against Routerly. No document-wide overflow; mobile tables need better task visibility. Provider scan, timestamp clarity, API-key labels, benchmark autosave instructions and overview density remain improvement targets.

history.title: Rounds 2–3 · verified workflows
history.text: 87 console tests pass. Independent browsers verify cancellation, clipboard values, pagination, focus, scoped usage, mobile access, both themes and absence of configuration writes during view changes. Full Go tests, race tests, vet and build pass. Enabled benchmark density and first-run dismissal remained review gaps.

history.title: Round 4 · functional gaps closed, verdict split
history.text: Compact six-column benchmark evidence, grouped provider choices and direct URL loading replace identified defects. First-run setup, key creation/deletion, persistent login and provider onboarding pass real UI smoke checks. Disposable Podman validation passes setup, encrypted credentials, rotation, restart, backup recovery, streaming accounting, quota enforcement and redaction. Critics differ on overall polish; operational overview and evidence details receive another round.

history.title: Round 5 · Oct 9 · operational hierarchy and restrained craft
history.text: Both independent reviewers now favor Torii overall on matched tasks after the operational overview, simpler shell, reversible provider choice, grouped UTC evidence and visible mobile navigation. Density/accounting ties are retained. A late provider keyboard focus regression was fixed and browser-tested; 99 console tests pass. Final embedded/container verification, full Go/race tests, vet/build, generated assets, documentation links and all eight live comparisons pass.
